CustomField.description: status not equal to close and no date entered
CustomField.formula:
IF( AND(ISNULL(Date_First_Closed__c),IsClosed = FALSE) , NOW() - CreatedDate ,
IF( AND(ISNULL(Date_First_Closed__c),IsClosed = TRUE), ClosedDate - CreatedDate,
IF( AND(NOT(ISNULL(Date_First_Closed__c)),IsClosed = FALSE), (Date_First_Closed__c - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate)) + (TODAY() - IF(ISNULL(Date_Reopened__c ),TODAY(),Date_Reopened__c)),
(Date_First_Closed__c - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate)) + (DATEVALUE (ClosedDate) - IF(ISNULL(Date_Reopened__c ),DATEVALUE (ClosedDate),Date_Reopened__c))
)))
CustomField.label: Age of Case (days)
